findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/DualNumber.lean:46 defines `DualNumber R := TrivSqZeroExt R R`, and Mathlib/Algebra/TrivSqZeroExt/Basic.lean:69 defines `TrivSqZeroExt R M := R × M`; `Module.finrank_prod` is at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dimension/Constructions.lean:161.
findings.fix: Delete `e`; change/unfold the module type to `k × k` and use `Module.finrank_prod` (then `simp`).
findings.issue: The local `e : DualNumber k ≃ₗ[k] k × k` manually packages the identity although `DualNumber k` unfolds through `TrivSqZeroExt k k` to `k × k`.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Quiver/Zigzag/Componentwise.lean:106 defines `zigzagAlgebra` as `AlgCat.of k (∀ C, zigzagComponentAlgebra k G C)`, so lines 137–145 rebuild an identity equivalence around that carrier.
findings.fix: Change the finrank expression directly to `Module.finrank k (∀ C, zigzagComponentAlgebra k G C)` and apply `Module.finrank_pi_fintype`; remove the local `e`.
findings.issue: The manually constructed projection/reconstruction linear equivalence duplicates the definitional carrier of `zigzagAlgebra`, which is already the dependent function type.

summary: Two hand-built identity linear equivalences duplicate definitional reductions and standard finrank lemmas.
